findings.title: Call to a nonexistent overload prevents compilation
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but its superclass only declares `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel)`, and neither `UsernameForm` nor its other ancestors declare a no-argument version. This leaves the changed source uncompilable, so the PR cannot build.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are disabled on the initial login form
findings.body: This predicate requires `context.getUser()` to be non-null, but the user is normally unidentified when the initial username/password form is rendered. As a result, `fillContextForm` is skipped on that form and the browser never receives the conditional WebAuthn challenge needed for passkey login. This also contradicts the added tests that expect passkeys on the initial login page.
